FIELDS.NAME: Eternal Rest Memorials
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Eternal Rest Memorials specializes in the design, creation, and sale of high-quality monuments and tombstones. Our operations encompass a range of services, including customized engraving and installation at cemeteries, ensuring each memorial reflects the unique story of those it honors. We work closely with families to provide personalized consultations, helping them choose the right materials, designs, and inscriptions that resonate with their loved ones’ legacies. Our inventory includes a variety of stone types and styles, all sourced from reputable suppliers, which helps us maintain exceptional quality standards. Additionally, we uphold stringent sanitation practices and safety protocols during production and installation processes to safeguard our employees and clients. Our commitment to compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations ensures a legally sound operation, contributing to our strong reputation within the community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In July 2023, a delivery truck carrying monuments was involved in an accident due to weather conditions, resulting in damages estimated at $2,500. The claim was successfully filed, and the amount was covered by our previous insurance policy. The status is resolved, and measures have been implemented to enhance transport safety in adverse conditions.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Grade Burial Vault, Reinforced Concrete, High-Quality Finish
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and a monitored alarm system to prevent vandalism and unauthorized access.
